name: glitchr/omnibill
description: Omnibill: one contract for transmitting and receiving electronic invoices - submit a conformant file (Factur-X, UBL, CII), follow its lifecycle statuses, receive suppliers' invoices, declare a status, look a company up in the directory, transmit e-reporting - whoever carries it: an e-mail (omnibill/email), an approved platform's standard API XP Z12-013 (omnibill/afnor), Chorus Pro (omnibill/chorus-pro); and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnibill/email: The invoice attached to an e-mail, its statuses kept by hand: the default gateway, and the tests'
suggest.omnibill/afnor: An approved platform (plateforme agréée) through the standard API XP Z12-013: flows and directory
suggest.omnibill/chorus-pro: Chorus Pro through PISTE: invoices to the public sector
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnibill\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibillBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnibill\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibillBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnibill\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibillBundle itself
